title: Site Copyright
description: Footer copyright line — "© {year} Agnosis (@agnosis@host)" on the main site, "© {year} {Artist Name} (@artistname@host)" on an artist's own subdomain — the parenthetical is always that actor's real Fediverse handle, so a visitor always has a copyable handle to follow from their own Fediverse client.
